protocol.selection: None; all candidates fixed before common-engine results
protocol.research_status: Retrospective comparison after both studies were examined; no independent untouched validation
protocol.delay_definition: PDF D first available at US session on/after D; shift that availability by 0/1/2 US sessions. All price features end at previous US close, unshifted.
protocol.zero_delay_assumption: Same-date PDF is available before US open; historical publication timestamps are not verified.
protocol.native_delay_difference: Claude original apply_delay shifts decision rows and their old scores; this comparison delays disclosures only by actual US sessions.
protocol.execution: Prior close signals; old shares earn overnight gap; rebalance fractional dollar allocations at observed regular-session Open; mark same-day Close; explicit trading cost0.
protocol.fx: KRW cash. Open conversions use previous US-session daily KRW=X Close as known-price proxy, not verified contemporaneous open FX. Close valuations use same-day daily FX Close.
protocol.price_basis: All P&L uses matching Yahoo split-reflected raw Open/Close; dividends and taxes excluded. No AdjClose/rawClose dividend factor in execution prices.
protocol.drawdown: Daily end-of-US-session KRW NAV drawdown including initial NAV1; not intraday or open-auction peak drawdown.
protocol.signal_warmup: Claude MOM120 retains AdjClose signal data from2025-05; our fixed20-day indicators retain2026-only warmup. Different information histories are disclosed.
protocol.schedule: Claude daily/weekly trades only on new available PDF; weekly first new-PDF session of ISO week. Our calendar daily/weekly schedule preserved. Cash starts enter at first eligible signal even midweek.
protocol.cash_start: Fresh June/August runs restart shares/cash but preserve past information; no pre-entry overnight gain. Continuous subperiod metrics retain inherited holdings.
protocol.position_limit: Fixed H6/H6e and our candidates <=10; TIME_clone full-US normalized fundweight is a reference and exempt from10-stock limit; not ETF share performance.
protocol.share_class_note: GOOG and GOOGL are distinct share classes. Both strategies use GOOGL as the merged-company proxy here; earlier our simulation used GOOG.
protocol.original_endpoint_difference: Claude original2026 runs endSep22; this common comparison endsSep23. Native reproduction stored separately.
protocol.execution_limit: Same-open dollar allocation uses aggregate opening prices to compute NAV and fractional shares; not exact previously submitted quantities or guaranteed actual fills. Actual slippage/spread/FX costs are unverified, not subtracted.

reference_etf_timing: KRX Close references from the original zero-cost study; intraday valuation/execution times differ from US-share paths.
